hints.title: Digit Transitions
hints.text: Every stepping number has the property that each consecutive digit differs from its predecessor by exactly one.

hints.title: Digit State Tracking
hints.text: Compute the count for numbers up to high and subtract the count for numbers up to low minus one using digit DP with tight and leading-zero flags.

hints.title: Memoized Construction
hints.text: Track current digit index, previous digit value, tight constraint, and whether a non-zero prefix has started. Transition to previous digit plus or minus one.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: d: number of digits in high string
complexity.notes: Digit DP memoizes across index, previous digit, and tight flags.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating across 10^100 numbers leads to exponential timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization requires space proportional to digit length times alphabet size.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply digit dynamic programming with prefix count subtraction f(high) - f(low - 1).
